<reason>PRO won a competitive debate by forcing a clean decision rule: CON admitted opposition even to a tightly safeguarded, temporary, returnable order, then never closed the suicide-gap or least-intrusive comparison. CON’s predicate/due-process replies were serious, but analogizing 2A as uniquely off-limits while accepting more severe pre-conviction deprivations left the motion easier to affirm than to reject.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s Q2 plus Rebuttal 2/closing: B still opposed C&C proof, a 14-day hearing, and automatic return, while the remaining tool after a 72-hour hold leaves the gun in the house—so CON’s alternative is more intrusive and less fitted to the core case.</best_rebuttal>
